name: Jehonadab
bio: Jehonadab (Jonadab) son of Rechab met Jehu on the road as Jehu was carrying out his purge of Ahab's house. Jehu asked whether Jehonadab's heart was right with his, and when Jehonadab said it was, Jehu took him up into his own chariot, inviting him to come see his zeal for the LORD. Jehonadab rode with Jehu into Samaria and into the house of Baal itself, witnessing Jehu's slaughter of Baal's worshippers and the destruction of Baal's temple (2 Kings 10:15-23). Generations later, his descendants, the Rechabites, were still obeying his command never to drink wine, build houses, or farm land; Jeremiah used their faithfulness as an object lesson for Judah's own failure to keep God's commands (Jeremiah 35:1-19).
